blurb: The Academy of Martial Arts (AMA) has been helping people of all ages build confidence through Traditional Martial Arts since 1988. Our community-focused environment supports individual progress, fostering discipline, physical fitness, and personal growth. With experienced instructors and a welcoming atmosphere, AMA empowers students to achieve their goals both on and off the mat.
